:::{#exr-rss-deriv-intercept}
#### Derivative of RSS with respect to the intercept

Find the partial derivative of the [simple linear regression](correlation-regression.qmd#def-slr)
residual sum of squares $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to the [intercept](correlation-regression.qmd#def-slr-intercept), $\partial \text{RSS} / \partial \intcoef$.

:::
